images.prompt:
Create a clean infographic-style illustration for a business article. 16:9 aspect ratio (1280x720px).

Topic: When AI gives everyone 80 points, 80 points become worthless. All outputs converge to the same average.

Visual concept: Five vertical bars arranged horizontally across the center, all exactly the same height and same muted green color #7BAE8E with slight transparency. They look almost identical — same width, same height, same spacing — emphasizing monotonous uniformity. Above the bars, a single horizontal dashed line in amber #D97706 labeled "80点ライン" in dark charcoal text. Below the bars, small identical labels "A社" "B社" "C社" "D社" "E社" in light gray #999. The visual message: everyone's output looks the same.

IMPORTANT TEXT RULES:
- The ONLY visible text: "80点ライン", "A社", "B社", "C社", "D社", "E社"
- DO NOT render any color codes, hex values, English translations, or design notes.

Style: Clean minimal infographic on warm off-white #EDEAE3 paper-textured background. Flat design with subtle gradients. Editorial magazine quality. Wide negative space. No people, no stock photos. Fill the entire canvas with the off-white background.

Create a clean infographic-style illustration for a business article. 16:9 aspect ratio (1280x720px).

Topic: Two types of assets discovered through AI model transition — one is durable, one needs recalibration but still valuable.

Visual concept: Two large horizontal layers stacked vertically. Top layer: a wide rounded rectangle with a thin amber #D97706 outline, filled with very light amber tint. Inside, the Japanese label "プロンプトの蓄積" on the left in dark charcoal, and on the right a small icon-like arrow curving back on itself suggesting 're-tuning' or 'adaptation'. A small subtitle below the label: "モデル移行時に再調整が必要 → 高速チューニング基盤" in smaller gray text. Bottom layer: a wide rounded rectangle with a thin green #2A8762 outline, filled with very light green tint. Inside, the Japanese label "評価軸" on the left in dark charcoal, and on the right a small shield or diamond icon suggesting 'durability'. A small subtitle: "モデルが変わっても書き直し不要" in smaller gray text. Between the two layers, a thin vertical bracket on the left side connecting both, labeled "二つの資産".

IMPORTANT TEXT RULES:
- Only Japanese text as specified above. No English, no color codes, no design notes.

Style: Clean minimal infographic on warm off-white #EDEAE3 paper-textured background. Flat design, editorial magazine quality, generous negative space. No people, no stock photos. Fill entire canvas.

Create a clean infographic-style 2x2 matrix illustration for a business article. 16:9 aspect ratio (1280x720px).

Topic: Investment portfolio for AI era — plotting business activities on two axes: AI evolution speed (vertical) and contribution to business results (horizontal).

Visual concept: A 2x2 grid matrix centered on the canvas. The vertical axis on the left is labeled "AIの進化速度" with "速い" at top and "遅い" at bottom, in dark charcoal text. The horizontal axis at the bottom is labeled "成果への寄与度" with "小" on left and "大" on right.

Four quadrants with subtle background fills:
- Top-left (fast evolution, high impact): light amber #D97706 tint, label "A 追従＋検証" in dark charcoal.
- Top-right (fast evolution, low impact): very light gray tint, label "C 捨てる" in gray text.
- Bottom-left (slow evolution, high impact): light green #2A8762 tint, label "B 集中投資" in dark charcoal, with a small star or emphasis mark suggesting this is the main focus.
- Bottom-right (slow evolution, low impact): very light gray tint, label "D 最低限維持" in gray text.

The bottom-left quadrant (B) should be slightly visually emphasized — perhaps a slightly thicker border or slightly stronger fill — to show it is the primary investment area.

IMPORTANT TEXT RULES:
- Only Japanese text as specified. No English translations, no color codes, no annotations.

Style: Clean minimal infographic on warm off-white #EDEAE3 paper-textured background. Flat design, editorial magazine quality, generous negative space. No people, no stock photos. Fill entire canvas.
